limitations: Only one guide edit since the walk was unwalked: 879fc477 replaced 'Approvals section and its Approvals & signing card' with 'Approvals tab'. The a9f1ffdb text is the walked content 45c6f916. The merge 789d2444 added no text of its own.

App changes to this guide's sources since 067c1646 are limited to the split of the Approvals & signing card into an Approvals tab and a Signatures tab (879fc477 and later signing commits), the owner fields moving into their own Overview section (791ad567) and an SSO column in auth.ts (fd8ffd71). The approval sub-components are byte-identical to 067c1646.

A prepared (embedded) send advances the Status only when the Contract's Status has not changed since preparation (recovery-stage.ts). Preparation is gated off by default, so the new sentence describes the direct send. The walkthrough can check the bypass with a direct send from a Contract at an Approval Status that holds a Pending approval, on a lab with a Signing connector.

The V-C16 registry text says 'cross the Soft gate deliberately'. That still holds for a Stage move from the Stage control. A send for signature crosses the line without the Soft gate; see productBugs.

productBugs.symptom: A confirmed send moves the Contract from an Approval Status to a Signature Status with no Soft gate warning and no override entry, even when approvals are Pending or Rejected. assertApprovalGate is called only from the Status PATCH in contracts/service.ts. Added by 879fc477.
productBugs.contradicts: CTR-012 Soft gate: advancing past approval with pending/rejected approvals warns loudly, is allowed, and is activity-logged as an override. CONTEXT.md Soft gate. No decision record covers the send-time Status advance; CTR-013 records only signature to active on completion.

sharedFileRequests.request: Step 3 implies every move past Approval can show Move past approval. Add that a confirmed send for signature moves the Contract to a Signature Status without the Soft gate and records no override.

The sentence 'A confirmed direct send moves the Contract to its first configured live Signature Status' should add that this move skips the Soft gate: no Move past approval dialog and no override, even with Pending or Rejected approvals.
